Our mission

The compliance market is growing.
We want it to shrink.

Every forecast says the same thing: compliance spending goes up, year after year. Consultants, questionnaires, audits, legal hours. Regulated companies pay more and move slower, and the rules keep coming.

Regulift is built for the opposite outcome. Less time, less money, less guesswork, so European companies can put their energy into products and markets. Compliance should be the reason you can compete, not the reason you can’t.

Two curves, one decisionIllustrative
Compliance spending, market forecastYour legal bill with Regulift
The target we are building towardsCut your legal bill by 60% before your lawyer even starts the clock.

The groundwork that eats most legal hours, collecting facts, mapping systems, assembling evidence, is exactly what software does well. Lawyers keep the part only lawyers can do: judgement.

Why we are different

Everyone else looks in from the outside.
We start from the inside.

Outside-in: questionnaires, interviews, snapshots.
Inside-out: your real systems, read securely, kept current.

The usual way: outside-in

They ask you to describe your company.

  • Forms and interviews that rely on memory
  • A snapshot that is out of date the week after
  • Billable hours spent collecting facts, not giving advice
  • Evidence assembled by hand before every review
The Regulift way: inside-out

We read what your company actually does.

  • Connects to your repositories, cloud, HR and CRM tools with read-only access
  • Builds your data and AI inventory from real flows, not recollection
  • Stays current as your systems change
  • Hands lawyers evidence, so their hours go to judgement
Read-only, by design

We never change your systems. We only read what the assessment needs, and you can revoke access at any time.

Hosted in Europe

Your materials and findings stay on European infrastructure, under European law.

Reviewed by real lawyers

Every outcome that matters is checked by a partner law firm, not generated by a model.

You own the record

Export your inventory and evidence whenever you want. No lock-in.

An illustrative story

How Regulift lifts
Northstar.

Northstar Technologies is a fictional 40-person software company in Berlin. This is how we design the journey to work. The numbers are our targets, not a customer result.

Week 0
The question

“Are we doing enough?”

Northstar sells workforce analytics and wants to expand into Italy and France. A prospect’s procurement team asks for NIS2 readiness and a position on the EU AI Act. The founders have a privacy policy from 2023, a security page, and no idea whether that is enough. A law firm quotes forty hours just to understand the setup.

Day 1
Connect

Read-only access to what matters.

Northstar connects GitHub, AWS, their HR platform and CRM to Regulift with read-only credentials, and uploads the policies they have. No interviews, no spreadsheet. By the afternoon, Regulift has mapped fourteen systems, six third-party processors and three models that make decisions about people.

Day 2
Understand

The picture nobody had drawn.

Two personal-data flows to a US analytics vendor were never documented. One scoring model falls into the AI Act’s high-risk category for employment. The cloud setup already meets most NIS2 controls, but there is no incident procedure on paper. Regulift turns this into an inventory, an evidence list and eleven concrete actions, ranked by what matters most.

Weeks 1 to 3
Improve

Clear actions, done in-house.

The team works the list: a processing agreement with the vendor, a retention schedule, an incident playbook, a human-oversight note for the scoring model. Regulift re-reads the systems and marks each item as evidenced. Nine of eleven actions close without a lawyer.

Week 4
Review

Sixteen lawyer hours instead of forty.

The partner law firm receives an organised evidence pack instead of a blank page. They review the high-risk classification and the two remaining open items, and sign off on a readiness statement. Northstar answers the procurement questionnaire the same week and keeps the deal.

A few things to know

Clear from the start.

Who is Regulift being built for?+

We’re starting with small and medium-sized European technology companies, especially teams navigating compliance without a dedicated department. Our long-term vision is to support companies across industries and sizes.

Does Regulift certify my company?+

No. The proposed platform provides an indicative assessment and helps you prepare for independent legal review. Any formal advice, assurance, or available certification would be handled separately by a qualified professional.

Which regulations are in the concept?+

Our illustrative dashboard features GDPR, the EU AI Act, NIS2, and DORA. The regulations relevant to a business depend on its activities and circumstances. This preview does not represent live assessment coverage.

Is this the same as hiring a law firm?+

No, and it is not a replacement either. Regulift does the groundwork: mapping your systems, building the inventory, collecting evidence and ranking the gaps. A partner law firm still reviews what matters. You get the same lawyer, with their hours spent on judgement instead of fact-finding.

How does inside-out access work?+

You connect your systems with read-only credentials, such as a code repository, cloud account, HR platform or CRM. Regulift reads what the assessment needs, nothing more, on European infrastructure. You can revoke access at any time and export everything we found.

Can I use the platform today?+

Not yet. Regulift is at concept stage. Join the early-access list and we will contact you when the first assessments open. We use your email for that purpose only.
